description: This header file defines the 'Wraps' class and its implementation interface 'WrapsImpl' which serve as abstractions for system and process management functions. It provides virtual methods for operations like executing system commands, opening pipes, reading mount entries, and handling secure command execution, along with static methods to access and modify these functionalities.

classes.name: WrapsImpl
classes.description: An abstract interface class that declares virtual methods for system-level operations such as executing commands, piping, logging, and reading mount information.

classes.name: Wraps
classes.description: A singleton-like class providing static accessors for system operations, which delegates to an implementation of WrapsImpl.

methods.name: Wraps(const Wraps &obj)
methods.description: Deleted copy constructor to prevent copying.

methods.name: setImpl(WrapsImpl* newImpl)
methods.description: Sets the implementation instance used by the Wraps class.

methods.name: getInstance()
methods.description: Provides access to the singleton instance of Wraps.

methods.name: popen(const char* command, const char* type)
methods.description: Opens a process by creating a pipe, for input or output.

methods.name: pclose(FILE* pipe)
methods.description: Closes a pipe opened by popen.

methods.name: syslog(int pri, const char* fmt, va_list args)
setmntent(const char* command, const char* type)
getmntent(FILE* pipe)
methods.description: Reads a mount entry from the mount table.

methods.name: v_secure_popen(const char* direction, const char* command, va_list args)
methods.description: Secure version of popen, supporting variadic arguments.

methods.name: v_secure_system(const char* command, va_list args)
methods.description: Secure version of system, supporting variadic arguments.

methods.name: readlink(const char* pathname, char* buf, size_t bufsiz)
methods.description: Reads the target of a symbolic link.
